about_the_game: In Slime Squisher, your main goal is to protect a strawberry by squishing slimes with your cursor. The slimes come in a variety of sizes and shapes. Some are fast, some are slow, some shoot bullets, and some are big and bulky!
detailed_description: In Slime Squisher, your main goal is to protect a strawberry by squishing slimes with your cursor. The slimes come in a variety of sizes and shapes. Some are fast, some are slow, some shoot bullets, and some are big and bulky!

short_description: Sime Squisher is a game where you need to protect a strawberry by squishing slimes. Choose upgrades, get more powerful and survive waves of deadly slimes!
